playstyle: Versatile with plus-frame pressure and the best sidestep in the game (Wavu). Make the opponent whiff with movement, then punish, and keep the turn with plus moves. Use back-turned (BT) and Dew Glide (DEW) for mix-ups. Her offence is very linear and weak to sidewalks to her left, so mix in homing moves.

stances.name: Back-turned
stances.entry: B after moves like df+2, ws2, f+1+2
stances.note: BT.1,4 is a Heat Engager; BT.1,2 tornadoes and is used in her BnB.

stances.name: Dew Glide
stances.entry: F after moves like b+1, 3,2 and f,F+3
stances.note: DEW.1,4 ends her combos; DEW.3 and DEW.2,1 are Wavu mini-combo follow-ups.

keyMoves: Fast check; 1,1 and 2,4 are her i10 punishes (Wavu).
